name: Astronomical Observatories of Kazan Federal University
description: Kazan Federal University runs two historic observatories in Russia's Tatarstan region. The city observatory, built in 1837 on the university campus, has a curved façade and three domed towers made for telescopes. The Engelhardt Observatory sits among trees in a park west of the city, with its observing structures and living quarters. Both still hold their original instruments and now mostly serve teaching.
